 SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 Out @ssc.gov.in, Download Response Sheet & Objection Link
 SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 has been released on November 4, 2026, at ssc.gov.in. Candidates can raise objections from November 4 to November 7 (9 PM) by paying Rs. 50 per objection. They can also download their response sheets, verify answers, and calculate their expected examination scores.

 SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 Out:  The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 on the official website. The provisional answer key with the response sheet has been released on November 4, 2026. Candidates can challenge the SSC CGL Answer Key from November 4 to November 7, 2026 (9 PM), by paying Rs. 50 per response through the official website. 
 SSC CGL Answer Key Notice PDF
 SSC CGL Answer Key Notice PDF has been released by the commission on November 4, 2026. It is to inform candidates about the CGL provisional answer key, response sheet, and to participate in the raise-objection process from November 4 to November 7, 2026. Visit the SSC CGL website to download the SSC CGL 2026 exam answer key and response sheet to calculate the probable scores. 
 SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 Download Link
 SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 Download Link is available for candidates on the official website. The login credentials include the Username (Registration Number) and Password (SSC Registration Password) to log in and download the provisional answer key and response sheet. 
 SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 Download Link (ACTIVE) 
 SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 Overview
 Candidates can get the direct link to download the CGL provisional answer key and response sheet from the commission’s official website. It can help candidates calculate the probable scores.

   Steps To Download SSC CGL Answer Key 2026
 Candidates can follow the steps given below to download the SSC CGL Answer Key 2026.
 Visit the official Staff Selection Commission website at ssc.gov.in.
 Click on the Answer Key section on the homepage.
 Find the link for the SSC CGL Answer Key 2026.
 Click on the answer key download link.
 Enter your Registration Number and Password.
 Submit the required login details.
 The SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 will appear on the screen.
 Check your question paper, correct answers, and recorded responses.
 Download the answer key PDF and save it for future reference.

 SSC CGL Response Sheet 2026
 Candidates can download the SSC CGL Response Sheet 2026 from the login portal. Use the Username (Registration Number) and Password (SSC Registration Password) to download the response sheet. The response sheet includes the answers to questions marked by the candidates in the exam. 
 SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 Raise Objection Link
 SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 Raise Objection Link is active on the website. Candidates can visit the login portal to mark the answer and object online. Submit the valid proofs with the fee payment from November 4 (9 PM) to November 7, 2026 (9 PM) by paying Rs. 50 per question.
 How to Raise Objection for SSC CGL Answer Key 2026?
 Follow the steps as How to Raise Objection for SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 .
 Step 1: Visit SSC official website. 
 Step 2: Go to the candidate's login portal.
 Step 3: Login using the Registration Number and Password. 
 Step 4: Click on the link for the candidate's response sheet, tentative answer key and submission of representations.
 Step 5: Select the question you want to challenge.
 Step 6: Upload the documents and pay Rs. 50 per response fee.
 Step 7: Submit the objection application. 
 How To Calculate Marks Using SSC CGL Answer Key?
 Candidates can calculate their estimated marks using the SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 by comparing their recorded responses with the correct answers. Follow these steps as How To Calculate Marks Using SSC CGL Answer Key. 
 Download the SSC CGL Answer Key 2026 and response sheet.
 Compare each response with the official correct answer.
 Award the prescribed marks for every correct answer.
 Deduct marks for each incorrect answer as per the exam's negative marking scheme.
 Do not add or deduct marks for unanswered questions.
 Calculate the total marks after applying the marking scheme.
 SSC CGL Marking Scheme
 Correct Answer: 2 Marks
 Negaitve Marking: 0.5 Mark
 Unattempted: NA
